item.title: Listen to This Podcast: KUOW Book Talk With Coll Thrush
item.description: What do Pacific Northwest shipwrecks have to do with settler colonialism? Author and historian Coll Thrush recently published a book, “Wrecked: Unsettling Histories from the Graveyard of the Pacific,” which explores this topic through six years of extensive research.
